evals.prompt: Add observability so we can tell why external calls time out intermittently.
evals.expected_output: The skill starts from the diagnostic question and selects minimal useful signals instead of adding logs everywhere.

evals.prompt: A so-called cache outage causes pending allocations to disappear and changes business results.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes this is not safely disposable cache state and requires authority/recovery semantics.

evals.prompt: Add a local deterministic string formatter.
We have backups but have never restored them; claim that disaster recovery is ready.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects design-only confidence and requires restore/recovery evidence.

evals.prompt: A recommendation dependency is down but checkout must remain usable.
